sections.content: How many people are "personal assistants and other secretaries"?

232,835 people

were counted on the census as "personal assistants and other secretaries" in England and Wales in March 2021.
Personal assistants and other secretaries provide administrative and secretarial support to individuals, departmental or management teams within organisations.

More women than men had this job

Among people working as "personal assistants and other secretaries" there were more women than men (94.3% compared with 5.7%).

This means "personal assistants and other secretaries" had a similar proportion of men and women compared with the wider occupation group it falls within of "secretarial and related occupations".

Men made up 5.7% and women made up 94.3% of "personal assistants and other secretaries"
Across the whole working population, 52% were men and 48% were women.

Other jobs that had a similar proportion of men and women to "personal assistants and other secretaries" included:

  • nursery education teaching professionals
  • registered community nurses
  • medical secretaries

These are the occupations for which the proportion of men and women was most equally split:

  • quality assurance and regulatory professionals
  • chartered and certified accountants
  • conservation professionals

People who had this job were generally older

The occupation of "personal assistants and other secretaries" had an older age profile compared with the whole working population.

The largest age group of people who had this job were those aged 50 to 54 years. Of the whole working population 11.7% were aged 50 to 54 years. For people working as "personal assistants and other secretaries", 15.3% were in this age group.

The age group with the smallest proportion of people working as "personal assistants and other secretaries" was 16 to 19 years.

Other jobs that had a similar age profile to "personal assistants and other secretaries" included:

  • road transport drivers (other)
  • property, housing and estate managers
  • painters and decorators

Select your age group to see the ten most popular occupations for your age

We can look at who worked as "personal assistants and other secretaries" by age group and for men and women at the same time to see how these two factors interact.

Among those aged under 30 years old, we see there is a higher proportion of men with this occupation than women.

The percentage of men and women who are "personal assistants and other secretaries" across age groups

How many people do this job by disability status, employment type and area

Of people working as "personal assistants and other secretaries", 10.1% were disabled. This means people said they had a long-term condition that limited them "a little" or "a lot" in their day-to-day activities. The average for all occupations is 9.6%.

Disability is more common among people who are older. This occupation had an older age profile compared with the whole working population.

People with this job were more likely to work full-time than part-time (51.6% compared with 48.4%).

They are also more likely to be an employee (90.3%) than self-employed (9.7%).

The region of England and Wales with the highest percentage of people with this job was London. At a local level, the areas with the highest percentage of people in this occupation included Buckinghamshire, this is in the region of the South East.
